summary: A request from Jon Postel for each site's technical liaison to send a description of their graphics facilities, for inclusion in the Resources Notebook, following a suggestion from the network graphics meeting.

plainLanguage.summary: After a network graphics meeting, participants suggested adding site graphics information to the Resources Notebook. This RFC asks each site to send a description of its facilities.

subtitle: A request for site information about network graphics equipment.

tldr.problem: Participants wanted the Resources Notebook to describe graphics facilities available at each site.
tldr.mechanism: Jon Postel asks each site's technical liaison or another knowledgeable person to send a description for editorial review.
tldr.outcome: The information would be considered for inclusion in the Resources Notebook and would not replace its normal update process.

sections.title: Request for Site Descriptions
sections.content: At a network graphics meeting at SAIL on November 21-23, participants suggested that the Resources Notebook include information about graphics facilities at each site. Jon Postel asks technical liaisons or other knowledgeable people to provide descriptions.
sections.plainLanguage: The Resources Notebook was to be considered for adding descriptions of graphics facilities. Each site was asked to provide information about its equipment and capabilities.

sections.title: Editorial Process
sections.content: The RFC states that this request would not replace other ways of updating Resource Notebook entries. Information collected would be submitted through the normal editorial procedures.
sections.plainLanguage: Submitted descriptions would go through the usual editorial process. The request was an additional way to gather information, not a replacement for other updates.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: The notice is a request to collect information from network sites for possible inclusion in the Resources Notebook. It does not specify a required format or detailed list of information to provide.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC asks sites to contribute descriptions. It does not set a template or specify exact details each description must contain.
